Looking at the `encode_cyclic` function, I need to understand what it does and then reverse the operation:

**Analysis of encode_cyclic:**
- Splits string into groups of 3 characters
- For groups with exactly 3 characters: rotates left by 1 (moves first char to end)
- Groups with fewer than 3 characters remain unchanged

**Implementation plan for decode_cyclic:**

• Split the encoded string into groups of 3 characters (same grouping logic as encoding)

• For each group with exactly 3 characters, rotate right by 1 position (move last character to front) to reverse the left rotation; groups with fewer than 3 characters remain unchanged

• Join all groups back into a single string and return the result
